answer: Stake-weighted reputation works like timber bracing a canyon wall: each new agent must post collateral proportional to its claimed identities, and every forged one draws from the same pool. Verification then taxes the whole pool per identity, so sybil clones pile up like wreckage on a reef, each clone raising the next clone's cost. Attacker's bottleneck: total collateral grows faster than any reward sybil spawning can return.
